name: Vostok-6
about: Vostok-6 (1963-023A), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1963 Jun 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1963 Jun 18), held fixed
